svg.title: Bronco openpilot research
svg.desc: The supplied Bronco illustration, uniformly scaled at its original 4:3 aspect ratio, beside upright Rubik Black lettering and a muted sage road-following graphic on an off-white background. Approved layout B, font choice 6.

g.title: Bronco research: cream and sage README studies
g.desc: Three integrated banner concepts with restrained road-following motifs. The original 1448 by 1086 JPEG is embedded unchanged and scaled uniformly in each instance. Source SHA-256: 9e31fcc0ef2218f5489b7f9a112d2b06f5e0461475bdb71250aee840739b9cbe. No stretching, perspective change or regenerated vehicle illustration. Background and typography made with image generation; original artwork composed as a separate layer.
